apps/academics/schema_repair.py.reason: Schema repair is DDL and has no ORM equivalent: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS / DROP DEFAULT / CREATE UNIQUE INDEX. Every interpolated identifier is passed through connection.ops.quote_name() and originates from module constants and model._meta.db_table -- never request data -- because SQL identifiers cannot be parameterized. Each site carries an rls-bypass-allow marker.

apps/analytics/management/commands/verif.reason: Read-only PostgreSQL extension readiness probe for pgvector; operator verification command only.
Read-only pgvector readiness and index diagnostics use pg_catalog, EXPLAIN, and row-count probes unavailable through ORM.

apps/analytics/semantic_search.py.reason: Vector similarity query uses pgvector distance operator with parameterized query and bounded result limit.

apps/api/sync_services.py.reason: Single constant statement, SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE, with no interpolation. Django FKs are DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED on PostgreSQL, so a per-row savepoint cannot observe a violation until COMMIT; flushing constraints is what makes a bad edge-sync row fail on the row that caused it instead of at the end of the batch.

apps/compliance/audit_retention.py.reason: Append-only audit purge bypasses ORM delete() guard via parameterized PK IN DELETE inside atomic transaction after archive signature verification.
